messages:
Maria Gonzalez: heads up — ACME amended their annual dedicated commit today; they prepaid $600,000 on 2025-01-01 for 12 months. amendment reduces future capacity starting 2025-08-01, customer requested partial refund. :thinking:
Andrew Cho: do we have the signed amendment? if yes, we need to recalc remaining deferral and decide refund vs credit to future invoices.
Maria Gonzalez: signed PDF is in sales-docs, link: https://drive.redwood/acme/amendment_signed.pdf
Emma Li: quick numbers check — original monthly recognition was $50,000/mo. as of 2025-07-31 we've recognized 7 months = $350,000. remaining deferred balance = $250,000.
Oliver Park: thanks. what's the new expected run-rate? are they asking full refund of the $250k or a pro-rated credit?
Maria Gonzalez: sales is proposing a pro-rated credit for the remainder: new monthly value is $30,000 for months 8-12 -> value = 5 * $30k = $150k. so refund amount = $250k - $150k = $100k.
Andrew Cho: ok that sounds reasonable. accounting question: do we treat the $100k as refundable liability (AP) or reduce deferred revenue and issue a credit note? thinking: reverse $100k from deferred revenue and create AP to customer for refund, then invoice-credit the $150k into future billings (or leave as deferral).
Emma Li: from rev rec POV we should adjust the remaining deferred schedule to reflect $150k recognized over remaining 5 months (Aug-Dec). and post a refund liability for $100k until cash is returned or applied.
Maria Gonzalez: can someone draft the journal entries for month-end (Aug 1) so we can post in July close? cc @Oliver for GL codes.
Oliver Park: draft JE below. GLs: 2200 = Deferred Revenue (liability), 2100 = Accounts Payable (customer refunds), 4000 = Revenue Recognized. post on 2025-07-31 (effective date for reclass).
Oliver Park: ```
Journal A — record refund liability (reverse portion of deferred):
Dr 2200 Deferred Revenue    $100,000
   Cr 2100 Accounts Payable (Customer Refund)   $100,000

Journal B — reconfigure remaining deferral schedule (no immediate rev impact):
Dr 2200 Deferred Revenue    $0
   Cr 2200 Deferred Revenue    $0
```
Maria Gonzalez: haha that second block is a noop — but ok. more usefully, we need a schedule update in RevenueBot so monthly recognition for Aug-Dec = $30k/mo. @RevenueBot can you export the revised schedule and attach to this thread?
RevenueBot: exported revised schedule for ACME (amendment applied). download: https://revenue.redwood/reports/ACME_2025_amendment_schedule.csv
BillingBot: created credit memo draft CM-2025-ACME-042 for $100,000, pending approval. link: https://billing.redwood/credits/CM-2025-ACME-042
Andrew Cho: ok next steps: 1) accounting posts Journal A to record refund liability, 2) billing issues credit memo if customer opted for credit instead of cash, 3) RevenueBot replaces schedule so Aug recognition = $30k/mo.
Emma Li: tagging policy note: since money was prepaid, refund reduces liability, we're not restating previously recognized revenue. good to confirm with external auditors? :white_check_mark:
Maria Gonzalez: @Oliver please confirm GL and post date. @Andrew can you approve the credit memo if sales accepts credit instead of cash?
Oliver Park: confirmed GLs and post date 2025-07-31. I'll prepare the JE and queue for review.
Andrew Cho: will approve credit memo once legal confirms T&Cs.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks all — summarize for month close: post JE for $100k refund liability, update deferred schedule to $150k remaining, billing to issue CM if needed. I'll attach amendment pdf to month close package. :thumbsup:
